newsitem.title: USA: Pharmacopeia hits milestone in Berlex pact.
newsitem.headline: Pharmacopeia hits milestone in Berlex pact.

text.p: Pharmacopeia Inc said on Thursday that it has received a cash milestone payment from Berlex Laboratories Inc as part of Berlex's decision to pursue an in vivo evaluation of a candidate compound identified by Pharmacopeia for treating multiple sclerosis.
A company spokesman declined to quantify the payment but said that the overall contract is worth about $20 million.
Phamacopeia said that Berlex has exercised its option to extend the term of its agreement and continue research in the current field.
Berlex is a unit of Schering AG.
